scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ai-chat/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @ai-chat/contracts" "npm run dev -w @ai-chat/api" "npm run start -w @ai-chat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-chat/contracts && npm run build -w @ai-chat/web && npm run build -w @ai-chat/api && node scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ai-chat/contracts && npm run lint -w @ai-chat/api && npm run lint -w @ai-chat/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-chat/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ai-chat/api && npm run typecheck -w @ai-chat/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ai-chat/contracts && npm run test -w @ai-chat/api && npm run test -w @ai-chat/web
